tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: God is my strength; mighty man of God
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength' or geber, 'man', + El, 'God' — 'God is my strength'. Its root is Hebrew g-b-r-ʾ-l. The archangel Gabriel (Daniel 8:16; Luke 1:19). Gabriel is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my strength; mighty man of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
